visualCharacteristics: A titled, horizontally-scrollable strip of product cards with prev/next arrows. Each card shows a product image (with an optional hover image), a product name link, a struck-through original price plus a special price, and a short description.
contentPattern: Optional title row (row label), then one row per product card: image (+ optional hover image) + name link + original/special price + short description.
usage: Sale page product carousels ('Shop These Limited-Time Deals', 'Best-Selling Sofas/Sectionals/Dining Tables/Beds on Sale').
